q: Tao's 2022 theorem on the Collatz conjecture proves that for any f(n)→∞:
opts: Almost all (density 1) orbits eventually reach a value ≤f(n) — orbits attain 'almost bounded' values
The orbit length is always O(log n)
exp: Tao (2022): for any f→∞, the set {n≤N: min_k C^k(n)≤f(n)} has density 1. Orbits almost surely reach very small values, but not necessarily 1. The proof uses Fourier analysis on ℤ₂ and sieve theory. The full conjecture (reaching exactly 1) remains open.
